svg.title: Dirac belt trick — a continuous 720-degree rotation
svg.desc: Six colored ribbons join a spinning cube to fixed outer mounts. After one full turn the ribbons have a different configuration; after two turns they return to their original configuration. Eight-second seamless loop. Native SVG paths, circles, gradients, and SMIL only; no raster images, JavaScript, or external dependencies.
svg.metadata: Original vector reconstruction inspired by Jason Hise, Belt Trick, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JaIR-cWk_-o . Geometry: radius-preserving quaternion homotopy; build_svg.py documents the construction.

g.text: Two full turns return the belts to their starting configuration.

g.inkscape:label: 04 · Animated cube and six belts — depth-sorted instances

g.text: One turn changes the belts. Two turns close the loop.
